items.title: Open coin recharge from Wallet or the red plus beside your gift balance.
items.detail: The shop shows the packs and prices available in your Google Play storefront.

items.title: Open Coin help from the shop or Wallet for purchase and refund guidance.
Eligible Android users can buy coin packs from the Wallet with Google Play.
items.detail: Kyron verifies the purchase before updating the balance, and unfinished purchases can be checked again in the Wallet.

items.title: Reward-funded gifts now generate withdrawable creator earnings on the same terms as purchased-coin gifts.
items.detail: Source remains recorded for reconciliation; grandfathered weekly complimentary gifts retain their legacy treatment.

items.title: Retire the automatic 100-coin weekly complimentary wallet top-up and its Monday push reminder.
items.detail: Existing unspent grants are preserved as legacy complimentary balances; new coins are issued through approved rewards.

items.title: The web app is withdrawn until further notice.
items.detail: Kyron is the Android and Windows apps; the website's "Log In" and sign-up buttons now lead to the download page, and old links to the web app land there too.

items.title: Passwords found in data breaches are turned away.
items.detail: Signing up or setting a password checks it against the Have I Been Pwned list of leaked passwords (only the first five characters of its fingerprint leave your phone), and asks for a different one if it is there.

items.title: The website sends headers that stop it being framed or content-sniffed, and the API no longer accepts calls from any web page.
Staff accounts can turn on two-step sign-in with an authenticator app, and the API can require it for moderation tools (STAFF_REQUIRE_SECOND_FACTOR).
